# Awesome Herdr [![Awesome](https://awesome.re/badge.svg)](https://awesome.re) > A curated plain-English index of tools built for **[Herdr](https://herdr.dev/)**, the app and runtime for running coding agents on every machine you own. Official links: [Website](https://herdr.dev/) · [Download](https://herdr.dev/download/) · [GitHub](https://github.com/herdrdev) · [Gallery](https://herdr.dev/gallery/) · [Guide](https://herdr.dev/guide/) · [herdr-core](https://herdr.dev/core/) · [Herdr TUI](https://herdr.dev/tui/) · [TUI Plugins](https://herdr.dev/tui/plugins/) · [Agent Skill](https://github.com/herdrdev/herdr/blob/master/skills/herdr/SKILL.md) · [Socket API](https://herdr.dev/tui/docs/socket-api/) ## Download Herdr

```sh # macOS (Apple silicon) and Linux (x86_64, arm64) curl -fsSL https://releases.herdr.dev/app/install.sh | sh # Windows (x86_64), in PowerShell powershell -c "irm https://releases.herdr.dev/app/install.ps1 | iex" ``` The desktop app installs [herdr-core](https://herdr.dev/core/) and updates itself. The iPhone, iPad, and Android apps connect to herdr-core over SSH. The original terminal app, [Herdr TUI](https://herdr.dev/tui/), installs with `curl -fsSL https://herdr.dev/install.sh | sh`. --- ## Contents 1.
